plot-title: The answer when a direction is added to the patches
plot-caption: Mean change of the 8-form answer margin of Gemma-4-31B against no addition, over the steered images, when a patch direction times the dose is added to all 256 image patches at 1 layer. Directions: fit on the mean patch (shared over 14 prompts, or the cool, pretty, ugly prompt alone), and a random control at the dose of the shared direction.
